name: az
description: Azure — manage resources with the Azure CLI, and Azure DevOps (projects, repos, pipelines, boards) through its azure-devops extension, signed in as a service principal.

settings.label: Service principal client ID
settings.description: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration to sign in as. Public information — it is on the app registration's overview blade, and safe to read back here.

settings.label: Entra tenant ID
settings.description: The directory (tenant) GUID the service principal lives in. A service principal sign-in is always tenant-specific, so `common` does not work here — use the GUID.

settings.label: Default subscription
settings.description: Subscription id or name to select after signing in, so commands need no `--subscription`. Leave empty to use whichever the service principal gets by default — which is fine when it can see only one.

settings.label: Azure DevOps organisation URL
settings.description: Full URL, e.g. `https://dev.azure.com/contoso`. Set as the `az devops` default so commands need no `--organization`. Leave empty if this plugin is only for Azure resources. Note the service principal must be added to the organisation as a user for any `az devops` command to work — existing in the tenant is not enough.

secrets.label: Service principal secret
secrets.description: The client secret of that app registration — Certificates & secrets -> New client secret. Write-only: encrypted at rest and never read back. Client secrets expire, so if commands suddenly fail to authenticate, check the expiry date before anything else.
